data_fields.donor_constant: retry after 300 ms while on the global cooldown

data_fields.name: global_cooldown_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: GlobalMSCoolDown = 1500 ms, set at cast start

data_fields.name: ability_cooldown_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: ability Cooldown (seconds) * 1000, set at cast start

data_fields.name: move_cancel_cast_ms
data_fields.donor_constant: cast longer than 1000 ms is cancelled by moving

data_fields.name: cast_time_damage_factor

best_idea: Make the action-point pool a second resource that regenerates by a fixed tick, pauses its regen while a global cooldown runs, and is spent when a cast lands, so a fast fight has a rhythm limit that a player can read off a bar.
decision_why: The AP pool with pausing regen and the global cooldown fit a fast fight and the server rhythm; the donor's per-ability cooldown alone is not enough for us, and its spend-at-completion gap is a defect: fix by reserving AP at start (or clearing the cooldowns on a failed completion) and by reporting the refusal to the caster.
acceptance: Server test: AP 40, an ability costing 30 casts; AP reads 10 only when the cast lands; a second ability press within 1.5 s is refused with the global-cooldown reason; regen adds 25 AP per second and holds during the global cooldown, retrying every 300 ms.
